meta.title: COH3 Maps Table - All Map Data Compared
meta.description: All Company of Heroes 3 multiplayer maps in one sortable table - resource point counts, max income per minute of fuel, munitions and manpower, map sizes and community maps.

page.title: Company of Heroes 3 Maps Table
page.subtitle: All the map data in one sortable table - resource points, income per minute and map sizes.
page.noMaps: No maps match the selected filters.

filters.incomeTooltip: Whether the income columns show the income of the whole map, or the estimated income of one side (half of the total).

tooltips.capturable: Total amount of points which can be captured by players - the player starting positions are not counted in
tooltips.incomeFuel: Fuel per minute at full control of the map
tooltips.incomeMunitions: Munitions per minute at full control of the map
tooltips.incomeManpower: Manpower per minute at full control of the map
tooltips.incomePerSideNote: Per side is half of the total - maps are close to symmetrical, but the points in the middle are contested rather than split, so treat it as an estimate.
tooltips.mapSize: Size of the map in world units (width × height)
tooltips.playableArea: Bounding box of the capture points - the part of the map the fighting happens on
tooltips.mapIdVersion: Map ID as used by the game files - scenario version {{version}}
